evidence.claim: The paper overstates generalization to new qubits by claiming no per-qubit tuning, but does not test on truly new or held-out qubits not seen during training.
evidence.excerpt: The paper states that the DCCNN requires “no per-qubit hyperparameter tuning” and, in Sec. The paper does not show evaluation on a held-out qubit, a genuinely new qubit template, or measured scans not represented in the synthetic training templates.
